'''Dagga Marl''' was the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] during his brief time as [[President of Ylesia|President]] of the [[Ylesian Republic]]. Sal-Solo chose her for her skill&mdash;something his [[Ylesian Presidential Guard|official guard]] lacked in abundance&mdash;and her [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] nature.

==Biography==
In exchange for one kilogram of [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]]&mdash;which had virtually replaced other currency on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]&mdash;every week, plus a bonus if he required her to kill someone, Marl kept a close eye on Sal-Solo, which she considered a challenge. Earlier in her career, she had worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] for the Ylesian Senate, and as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="NJOY">''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''</ref>

===Capture===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Farglblag?"<br />"''Sorry.''"<br />"''How do you ''spell'' it?|Dagga Marl and Thrackan Sal-Solo|<ref name="NJOY" />}}
Marl and Sal-Solo were both captured by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] at the [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|Battle of Ylesia]]<ref name="NJOY" /> in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]'', which includes the [[Battle of Ylesia (28 ABY)|Battle of Ylesia]] and [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]]'s use of "Dagga Farglblag," to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref> Assuming the mantle of Ludus Fazum, the Peace Brigade leader claimed himself and his companion to be a couple who were [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] from the<ref name="NJOY" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''&mdash;Based on corresponding data for [[Falleen system/Legends|Falleen system]]</ref> of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] that were taken to the<ref name="NJOY" /> [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] world<ref name="Atlas2">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] to work as house [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]; Sal-Solo had, in fact, been appointed [[President of Ylesia]] by the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The ruse failed when Sal-Solo's cousin and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] arrived on the scene and arrested Sal-Solo and Marl.<ref name="NJOY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dagga Marl appeared in [[Walter Jon Williams]]' [[2002]] [[eBook]], ''[[The New Jedi Order: Ylesia]]''.<ref name="NJOY" />
